spans.s: The plant Semecarpus Anacardium (भल्लातक; Mar. बिब्बा).आ
Who or what calls, a crier.
A name, appellation, oft. at the end of comp.; अमृताह्वः शताह्वा &c.
आह्वयः [āhvayḥ], 1 A name, appellation (as last member of comp.); काव्यं रामायणाह्वयम् Rām.; चक्रसाह्वयम्, चरणाह्वयाः; वृद्धेरप्याह्वया इमे Ak.
A law-suit arising from a dispute about games with animals, as cock-fighting &c.; (one of the 18 titles of law); पणपूर्वकपक्षिमेषादि- योधनं आह्वयः Rāghavānanda on
आह्वयन [āhvayana], a. Taking one's name. -नम् Name, appellation.
आह्वरकः [āhvarakḥ], A low or expelled man (who, after having offered a sacrifice to the manes, takes the sacrificial food for himself); अन्नमपहर्तार आह्वरका भवन्ति श्राद्धे सिद्धे
आह्वारकः [āhvārakḥ], A recension of the black Yajurveda.
A call, invitation, summons (in general); सुहृदाह्वानं प्रकुर्वीत
A legal summons (from court or govt. to appear before a tribunal);
Invocation of a deity; जन्म- ज्येष्ठेन चाह्वानं सुब्रह्मण्यास्वपि स्मृतम्
N. of a liturgical formula. -Comp. -दर्शनम् day of trial.
आह्वानयति [āhvānayati], Den. P. (In law) To summon.
आह्वायक [āhvāyaka], a. Calling, inviting. -कः A messenger, courier; आह्वायकान् भूमिपतेरयोध्याम्
आह्वृ [āhvṛ], 1 P. Ved. To make crooked, injure.
आह्वृत [āhvṛta], p. p. Injured; ˚भेषज a. curing what is injured or bent;
To invite, invoke (in a liturgical sense).
(Ā.) To provoke, challenge; कृष्णश्चाणूरमाह्वयते Sk.; आह्वत चेदिराण्मुरारिम् Śi.2.1;
To send for, call; कविमाह्वाययामास प्रस्तुतप्रतिपत्तये
To cause to invite or summon.
